verdict.rationale: Clerky documents its own catalog of standardized legal paperwork that founders fill in without drafting from scratch: formation, safes and convertible notes, hiring documents for employees, consultants and advisors, and stock plans, with customizable key terms and underlying forms. However, the evidence never names NDAs or policies, never describes the forms as vetted, and offers no independent corroboration that they replace hiring counsel. missing for 10: explicit NDA and policy templates, evidence the templates are vetted or attorney-drafted, a described browsable template library, independent confirmation that founders skip counsel for routine documents.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start from a library of vetted standard legal templates (NDAs, agreements, policies) instead of hiring counsel for routine documents

citations.quote: Issue safes or convertible notes. Hire employees, consultants, and advisors, and issue stock or stock options as equity compensation.
Forming a startup on Clerky enables access to a legal dashboard that makes it easy to do additional legal paperwork.
Our software makes it easy to customize the key terms of the legal paperwork you're working on.
If you need to customize documents beyond the provided fields, you can swap out the underlying forms for any of our products.
Adopt a stock plan to easily issue restricted stock or stock options to employees, consultants, and advisors.
